heading: WWE Hall of Famer Kevin Nash accused of having an affair with brother-like friend's ex-wife
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 20, 2026, 10:19 IST
paragraphs: WWE legend Kevin Nash has been in the headlines for his wrestling career and personal life for years

However, in a recent development, the former WWE Champion was accused of one of the most shocking betrayals in life: secretly having an affair with the ex-wife of someone he called a brother for years
That man is none other than his best friend and fellow WWE Hall of Famer, Scott Hall

More shockingly, the accusation came straight from Hall's wife, Dana Hall.Dana Hall accused Kevin Nash of having a secret affair with herIn a recent appearance on Monte and The Pharaoh, Dana Hall made the shocking revelation that she and Kevin Nash had a secret affair behind Scott Hall's back in the late 2000s
Dana said, "This happened in 2008; Kevin was married
Kevin was the one that’s been shouting from the rooftops that he’s his best friend." She further revealed that the duo hooked up three to four times. "It was like three or four times

I know for three times I can remember for sure, but just, yeah, like booty calls or whatever."However, Dana realized Nash wasn't serious about her after discovering signs that he was hooking up with other women.”I would go there sometimes, and there would be makeup on the pillow from the girl that was before me”, said Dana

At the same time, it is important to note that the secret hookups happened years after Scott Hall and Dana had divorced, first in 1998 and then again in 2001 after they remarried in 1999.WWE Hall of Famers Kevin Nash and Scott Hall formed one of the most iconic factions of all timeKevin Nash and Scott Hall became top WWE superstars during the 1990s and then jumped ship to rival competition, WCW, debuting as 'The Outsiders.' After weeks of teasing a third man to join them, they revealed it to be none other than the ultimate good guy, Hulk Hogan, who turned heel in one of the biggest shockers in professional wrestling
